{{Quote|Chief Okko, I believe your ancestors were Jedi.... You can be Jedi.''"<br />"''We are not Jedi. We are Ysanna. We do not need you to teach us anything. Ysanna magic is strong.|Luke Skywalker and Okko|<ref name="DEII4">[[Dark Empire II 4|''Dark Empire II'' 4]]</ref>}}
A group of '''Jedi survivors'''<ref name="NoP" /> were the ancestors of the tribal [[Ysanna/Legends|Ysanna]] in the years following the [[Battle of Ossus (Great Sith War)|destruction]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] during the [[Cron Supernova/Legends|Cron Supernova]] in [[3996 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

Unable to get off-world in [[Time/Legends|time]] before the [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] [[Radiation/Legends|irradiated]] the planet,<ref name="GatORW" /> a few<ref name="TEA" /> [[Force power/Legends|powerful]]<ref name="NoP" /> [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] families<ref name="TEA" /> took refuge in the vast subterranean<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> [[Crystal Caves (Ossus)/Legends|Crystal Caves]] beneath the [[Eocho Mountains/Legends|Eocho Mountains]]. In the rush to collect as many [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystals]], the Jedi became trapped in the [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]] [[Cave/Legends|caves]] by a collapse in part of the tunnel. The safety of the caves saved the group from<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref> the extinction-level event.<ref name="TEA" />

Abandoned for [[Death/Legends|dead]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="POTJ" /> the survivors banded together<ref name="NoP" /> and attempted to create their own society from the ashes<ref name="POTJ" /> to survive the vast wasteland Ossus had become.<ref name="NoP" /> Over the [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] and the course of generations,<ref name="GatORW" /> the Jedi's descendants lost the proper understanding of [[The Force/Legends|The Force]] and<ref name="POTJ" /> forgot their Jedi heritage.<ref name="GatORW" /> They were the progenitors of the Ysanna people that would come to roam the wastes of Ossus and protect its ruins.<ref name="NoP" />

{{Company-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedi survivors were first mentioned in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in [[Dark Empire II 4|''Dark Empire II'' 4]], a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] written by [[Tom Veitch]], illustrated by [[Cam Kennedy]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="DEII4" /> on [[March 21]], [[1995]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54066/star_wars_dark_empire_ii_1994_4|text=Star Wars: Dark Empire II (1994) #4}}</ref>
